rules.text: Use Kickback for all trump suits. When Kickback occupies a suit bid, NT becomes the cue-bid for that suit.
4M−1: Last Train（最后一班车）. Partnership agreement needs discussion.
Competitive methods: responder uses transfers, switched bids, and bids that show a fit. After a double or redouble at the one-level, our third double, including redoubles, is for penalties.
Four-level minor bids after a major opening: when the opponents show two specified suits, 4♣ is a slam try with shortness in their lower suit. 4♦ is a slam try with shortness in their higher suit.

Four-level minor bids after a major opening: when only one opponent suit is known, including a natural three-level preempt, 4♣ is a good raise to game with control in their suit. A following 4♦ asks for extra values. 4♦ directly is a slam try without control. 4M is a natural raise; with opening strength, it denies control.

When they double our cue-bid: Pass often denies control. Partner redoubles with the ace, or cue-bids with KQ or shortness. An immediate redouble shows the queen or better. An immediate cue-bid says that we can handle the situation.
